name: Codex CLI
description: Runs a coding agent locally in the terminal, editing files and executing commands inside an OS sandbox with configurable approvals, plus headless `codex exec` for pipelines.

skills.name: Sandboxed Code Execution
skills.description: Edits files and runs shell commands inside an OS-level sandbox, escalating to the user for approval per the configured permission mode.

skills.name: Headless Exec Runs
skills.description: Executes prompts non-interactively through `codex exec` so coding tasks run inside CI jobs, scripts, and other repeatable workflows.

skills.name: MCP Server Integration
skills.description: Attaches local or remote MCP servers via `codex mcp` and exposes Codex itself as an MCP server for other agent clients.

skills.name: Session Resume
skills.description: Reopens a recent conversation from the current repository with `codex resume` and searches across stored local sessions.

skills.name: AGENTS.md Project Config
skills.description: Generates and reads AGENTS.md instructions through `/init` so repository-specific conventions steer the agent on every run.
